_comment: DESIGN.md v2 §F. Every decision number used by code lives here; code reads it via biomark.paths.load_config('design_params'). Frozen (sha256 in configs/frozen_hashes.json) at tag freeze-design; later changes need a D-entry (DESIGN §13.4). Keys are grouped by DESIGN section.

dependency_s2.accurate_dependent_rule: observed dependent AND fold-centred prediction rank (most negative first) <= n_g, n_g = number of dependent D lines of g
dependency_s2.R_accurate_dependent_rule: R refit prediction <= quantile(R predictions, n_g/n_D) (target-free, computed before freeze-catalogue)

dictionary_s3.lof_bi_rule: damaging dosage 2 OR (dosage >= 1 AND (own CN < cn_loss OR SIL)) OR (X-linked AND male AND dosage >= 1)

fusion.driver_list: configs/fusion_drivers.csv (built from CIViC/MOAlmanac fusion profiles and OncoKB fusion genes)

dictionary_s3.hypermutated_rule: MSI OR DMG_BURDEN in top hypermutated_top_frac of D

spectra_if_mutation_file.SIG:SPEC_POLE: 1 if SNV count >= D 99th percentile AND indel/SNV ratio < 0.05
spectra_if_mutation_file.SIG:SPEC_TOBACCO: C>A fraction among SNVs, SPEC_POLE lines excluded (NA)
spectra_if_mutation_file.SIG:SPEC_UV: fraction of CC>TT dinucleotide substitutions among all substitutions

surrogate_s4.subsample_design: complementary halves, patient-grouped, lineage-stratified; seed seeds.json:subsample_seed

library: library_group (screen-map: Avana-only, KY-only, Humagne-only, Avana+KY, other)
culture: base-medium family {RPMI, DMEM, IMDM, DMEM-F12, other, unknown}
gene: own CN of g (log2, NA->0 + CN_absent)

drop_rules: covariate is d or in d's locus group
own CN omitted when d is CN-derived and its locus group contains g (own-CN-adjusted = sensitivity)
TP53 omitted when d derives from TP53 or MDM2 amplification
confounders_s5.se_type: patient-clustered sandwich: CR1 (vectorised) for all tests; CR2 for D-stage screen, ceiling and R tests
confounders_s5.media_column_rule: parse base medium from the column whose values match the formulation regex in >= 90% of non-empty cells (Model.csv OnboardedMedia/FormulationID appear swapped); screened condition first (ModelCondition), else Model.csv, else unknown

s1_s5.test: OLS partial t on FWL residuals; F = t^2 (= Gaussian LRT); df = n - rank(Z) - 2

md_strict_s5.d_stage_test: confounder model on observed D effects, CR2
md_strict_s5.pass: same sign as selection AND BH q_sc < 0.05 within EN-pred selected candidates
md_strict_s5.label: selection_conditional (nominal); error rate reported = empirical FDR (§7)

test_families_s5.F1_S1_main: all (g,d) in U with d not EXPDOSE own; BH at count run
test_families_s5.F2_S1_EXP_own: EXPDOSE own tests; separate BH; never counted toward recall of non-expression biomarkers
test_families_s5.F3_EN_D_stage: EN-pred (and EN-obs) selected candidates; BH q_sc; screening only
test_families_s5.F7_cgt_ceiling: S/W CGT tests with >= 3 carriers; BH q < 0.1

replication_s6.shrinkage: empirical-Bayes normal scale mixture (20 log-spaced sigma, EM <= 500 iter) fitted once on all F1 S1-obs (beta, SE); posterior mean; identical for all arms
replication_s6.power_formula: Phi(|beta_shrunk|/SE_R_pred - z_0.95), SE_R_pred from D residual SD and R carrier counts (molecular data only)
replication_s6.R_nan_pattern: expected non-NaN genes per R line from its library (D-derived library NaN sets)
replication_s6.xlib_replication: D lines with no Avana screen

null_s7.unit: one within-stratum permutation of line labels applied jointly to all 𝒟 rows (shared and gene-specific); y, predictions and covariates fixed
null_s7.strata: lineage x library_group; strata < 2 lines merged into the lineage's largest stratum
null_s7.raise_rule: B = 50 iff 50 x wall(permutation 1) <= wall_cap_min, decided from timing only, before any observed-run output is read

negative_controls_s7._comment: Provisional bounds; scripts/simulate_control_bounds.py replaces each with the 95th percentile of its toy null at real D dimensions before freeze-design (AF8). The replacing commit must precede any real-data control run.

cross_lineage.meta: REML tau2, HKSJ CI, I2, tau, 95% prediction interval
cross_lineage.lolo: sign kept when each contributing lineage is dropped
cross_lineage.restricted: per-lineage BH q < 0.05 (F5) AND d x lineage interaction LRT p < 0.05

clustering_tierC.input: fold-centred M5 OOF over eligible genes, raw and lineage-residualised

gate_s9.recovered: (g, primary or secondary feature) in the list with the expected sign
gate_s9.gate_eligible: dependency gene has >= 100 non-NaN D lines AND feature in 𝒟 with >= min_carriers (binary) or available (continuous)

clinical_s10.family_rule: recovered if any member hit; ceiling uses Bonferroni x |T| within the test
tiers: T1 regulatory approval with label biomarker
T2 CIViC A/B Supports or NCCN-cited, not approved

excluded: parrish2021 (counts only; processed GI tables blocked)
combinatorial_s11.gold_standard: hit in >= 2 screens or >= 2 cell lines
combinatorial_s11.background: screened pairs matched on sequence-identity decile and family size

lmm_s6.kernel: D-only dependency profiles of non-eligible genes

toy_s13.predictor: ridge trained by 5-fold CV on noisy toy observations, plus per-fold offsets
